name: finance-app-claude
description: Finance intelligence prototype: news → discovery → analysis → dashboard

scripts.dev:clean: sh -c 'for p in 8787 5173 5174; do lsof -ti tcp:$p 2>/dev/null | xargs kill -9 2>/dev/null; done; true'
scripts.dev: concurrently -k -n server,client -c blue,green "npm run dev -w server" "NODE_TLS_REJECT_UNAUTHORIZED=0 wait-on -t 120000 --httpTimeout 10000 https-get://127.0.0.1:8787/api/health && npm run dev -w client"
